meta.note: The plot is not a texture: a black ground with two grid layers drawn live, a glow, and tube artefacts on top. Every value is read from the board source.

scale.rule: minor cell is the step whose on-screen size (pxPer1000kmAt1x x zoom / 1000 x km) is nearest 61 px

layers.anchor: both layers centred on the plot: lines at x = (plotW - cellW) / 2 + n x cellW, y = (plotH - cellH) / 2 + n x cellH (CSS background-position 50% 50%)

RED.alsoOn: the white glow layer stays on under the red tint

tube.above: grid and contacts; no pointer input

scanlines.rule: 1 px black line every 3 px; alpha = crtScan / 100 x 0.9

vignette.rule: radial ellipse at 50% 48%; clear to (72 - crtVignette x 0.35)%, black to alpha crtVignette / 100 x 0.95 at the edge
